skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Heals an allied target for HP equal to 100% ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Heals all allies for HP equal to 100% ATK and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies for 2 turns. [Lock]: Prevents the affected unit from triggering [Follow-Up], [Continuous Follow-Up], and [Combo Follow-Up]. Before any character acts, deals 150% ATK [Lock] DoT to the affected unit (can CRIT and cannot be [Evaded]).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies, with each hit dealing 600% ATK DMG. Heals all allies for HP equal to 150% ATK and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies for 2 turns. [Lock]: Prevents the affected unit from triggering [Follow-Up], [Continuous Follow-Up], and [Combo Follow-Up]. Before any character acts, deals 200% ATK [Lock] DoT to the affected unit (can CRIT and cannot be [Evaded]).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies, dealing 150% ATK DMG and lasting 1 turn. [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies, dealing 150% ATK DMG and lasting 1 turn. [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies, dealing 150% ATK DMG and lasting 1 turn. [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: For the first 5 rounds, at the start of each round, apply [Limited Energy Deduction] to all enemies. ———— [Limited Energy Deduction]: Deducts 4 energy points (once per round); after a successful deduction, the enemy cannot be inflicted with [Panic]/[Specialized Panic] again in the same round.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: [Basic Effect]: Gain 3 Energy per turn. Grants allies' [Non-Crit DMG Free] and Specialized Evasion effectiveness against [True Damage]. Doubles the damage reduction effect of [Specialized HP]. During the first 5 turns, at the start of each turn, inflicts [Extreme Energy Drain] on the enemy (removes 4 Energy; can only trigger once per turn. After a successful drain, the target cannot be affected by [Fear/Specialized Fear] in the same turn, and their Total Damage Bonus is reduced by 25% for 1 turn). [Require]: Deploy 1 Duelist, 1 Grappler, 1 Esper. [Advanced Effect]: On deployment, all allies gain the [Specialized HP] effect. For every cumulative consumption of [Specialized HP] equal to 175% of Max Health, gains [Extreme Unyielding]. ———— [Specialized HP]: Grants the unit [Specialized HP] equal to 250% of its base Max Health, with a cumulative maximum of 700%. [Specialized HP] reduces all incoming damage by 30%. [Extreme Unyielding]: Become immune to all damage. Effect is removed after any 3 characters have acted. [Require]: Deploy 1 Duelist, 1 Grappler, 2 Esper.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: [Basic Effect]: Gain 4 Energy per turn. Grants allies' [Non-Crit DMG Free] and Specialized Evasion effectiveness against [True Damage]. Increases the damage reduction effect of [Specialized HP] by 2.2 times. During the first 5 turns, at the start of each turn, inflicts [Extreme Energy Drain] on the enemy (removes 5 Energy; can only trigger once per turn. After a successful drain, the target cannot be affected by [Fear/Specialized Fear] in the same turn, and their Total Damage Bonus is reduced by 25% for 1 turn). [Require]: Deploy 1 Duelist, 1 Grappler, 1 Esper. [Advanced Effect]: On deployment, all allies gain the [Specialized HP] effect. For every cumulative consumption of [Specialized HP] equal to 175% of Max Health, gains [Extreme Unyielding]. ———— [Specialized HP]: Grants the unit [Specialized HP] equal to 250% of its base Max Health, with a cumulative maximum of 700%. [Specialized HP] reduces all incoming damage by 30%. [Extreme Unyielding]: Become immune to all damage. Effect is removed after any 3 characters have acted. [Require]: Deploy 1 Duelist, 1 Grappler, 2 Esper.
